stories.section: Front Page · Wizarding Jeep Enthusiast Society
stories.headline: Duck Bandit Identified; Purpose Revealed; the Wizarding World Takes a Moment
stories.byline: By our Creature Accessory and Charmed Array correspondent
body: The Duck Bandit, whose five-day campaign of precision duck-placement and haberdashery has occupied three county constabularies, the WJES Cartographic Division, and one Ministry Grade Two Purposeful Array advisory, has been identified. The Prophet can confirm that the Bandit is not, in fact, a rogue enchanter, a misdirected Auror trainee, or a sentient geographic phenomenon. The Bandit is, by all available evidence, a collective: a loose and cheerful confederation of wizarding Jeep owners across three counties who know Christine and Steve by reputation — specifically, as the pair who once, at a muddy crossroads in the Gorge in a gathering fog, stopped to help four strangers winch a stuck rig out of a hollow and then drove away before anyone could say thank you.

The ducks, the accessories, the orientation — all of it was a thank-you note, constructed over several weeks by people who knit well and navigate by landmarks. The convergence point was always the Jeep. The burgundy waistcoat duck, placed Sunday, was the signature. A card, folded inside the waistcoat's lapel pocket and approximately the size of a Chocolate Frog wrapper, reads: 'You didn't wait to be asked. Neither did we. Safe trails.' It is unsigned. It has been laminated and added to the household ledger.
Lucy was near the Jeep at 4:47 a.m. The moon, reached for comment, continues to decline. The Prophet has elected not to resolve this particular question.

stories.headline: Monday Client Arrives with a Spreadsheet; Christine Has Already Seen This Spreadsheet; She Has Notes
stories.byline: By our Diagon Alley financial correspondent
body: A Monday-morning client arrived at Christine's office carrying what he described as 'a comprehensive breakdown' of his Gringotts holdings, formatted across seventeen columns. Christine had received a copy by owl Friday. She had annotated it over the weekend. Her annotations occupy a second document of comparable length, organised by tab.

The meeting lasted forty minutes. The goblins, who had positioned themselves outside the door expecting a lengthy standoff, dispersed quietly at the thirty-five-minute mark when they heard the tone shift from negotiation to agreement. One was observed pressing his ear briefly to the door. He offered no explanation.

stories.headline: Ministry Closes Grade Two Purposeful Array Advisory; Cites 'Resolution of an Affectionate Nature'; Files It Under 'Wholesome, Misc.'
stories.byline: By our Whitehall and Magical Governance desk
body: The Department of Magical Creatures (Charmed Object Sub-Division) has officially downgraded and closed the Grade Two Purposeful Array advisory issued Sunday in response to the aligned duck formation centred on a private Jeep in the Gorge region. In a brief statement, the Department noted that the array had been 'purposeful, yes; threatening, no; in fact rather moving, upon review.'

The glowing briefcase that has been circulating through Ministry corridors since late August was briefly observed in the office of the Sub-Division Head on Monday morning. He declined to open it. It has been moved to a shelf. The shelf is warm.

stories.headline: Monday Resumes; the Card Is Laminated; the Household Takes Stock of the Week Ahead
body: Following a Sunday that included a cartographic revelation, a Ministry advisory, a burgundy waistcoat, and a note small enough to fit in a lapel pocket, Monday arrived at the household in the way Mondays do — with a fairly long list and a moderate amount of coffee.

Steve inspected the Jeep in good morning light, confirmed all eight ducks present and undisturbed, and reported the rig in good order. The enchanted Jeep, per its custom, forgave him for last Tuesday's drainage ditch without being asked. It was considered a good omen.

familiars_corner: Lucy: Was located on the porch at first light, facing northeast, for reasons she considers entirely her own. No biscuit tin was disturbed. These two facts are not necessarily related.
Ellie: Discovered the laminated card on the table this morning and sat with it for some time, certain it was important. She is correct. She does not know why. She is still correct.

Jersey: Has identified the precise square of Monday morning sunlight that has migrated to the left side of the sitting room and has adjusted his position accordingly. He considers this a form of expertise.
founding_editor_note: I built something once that people came back to say thank you for, years later. Didn't need a card. Knew anyway. Build things worth coming back to. — D.

in_brief.sport: The Gringotts Invitational Ledger-Lift was postponed Monday when the ledger in question turned out to contain the actual financials; Christine has been asked to supervise the rescheduling.
in_brief.forecast: Clear over the Gorge by midweek; eight ducks facing forward; one duck facing wherever Lucy pointed it; the week ahead is considered, on balance, good.

storyline_updates.title: The Duck Bandit Chronicles
storyline_updates.summary: Resolved Monday. The Duck Bandit was revealed as a collective of wizarding Jeep owners across three counties, thanking Christine and Steve for an unremarkable act of trail kindness that Christine and Steve had already forgotten. The convergence point was always the Jeep. The card — 'You didn't wait to be asked. Neither did we. Safe trails.' — has been laminated and added to the household ledger. Lucy's 4:47 a.m. involvement remains gloriously unresolved.

storyline_updates.title: The Briefcase
storyline_updates.summary: Day 1: The glowing briefcase, circulating through Ministry corridors since late August, was observed Monday morning in the office of the Sub-Division Head of the Charmed Object Sub-Division. He declined to open it. It has been placed on a shelf. The shelf is warm. Day 2 should develop its circulation — perhaps it moves overnight, or a second Ministry official is found in proximity to it, or its glow changes colour in the presence of a specific person.
